Aatrox.escape: The moment after Aatrox uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash is an opportunity to engage with Singed E Fling. Check that you have avoided the outer edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and the pull from Aatrox W Infernal Chains before going in. Singed has no ability to escape on his own, so don’t start recklessly within range of being caught.
Aatrox.phase: After two core items, keep pushing the lane and drawing the enemy around. In the late game, don’t let time pass without getting items.
Aatrox.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team, but check your direction so you don’t throw an enemy out of the middle of your team. Keep moving after the throw to draw several enemies into chasing you, and survive.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, avoid giving up kills, collect CS, and keep Aatrox tied to the lane. Try pushing the wave under the enemy turret and clearing the next wave with poison from behind the turret only just after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. Don’t go behind the turret if you don’t know where the enemy jungler is.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Dead Man's Plate provides armor and movement-related interactions that suit Singed’s style of managing distance while running.
Aatrox.combo: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and keep moving to make Aatrox walk through the poison. When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, use Singed E Fling to throw him in a favorable direction, then place Singed W Mega Adhesive at his landing point to root him. Near a turret, throw him into its range and place adhesive at his landing point.
Aatrox.fight: Early on, look for the moment just after Aatrox uses his empowered Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance attack on a minion. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run past Aatrox to lay poison, then catch him with Singed E Fling when Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down. Don’t stand still to trade basic attacks or accept a duel while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals heavy damage and can knock you up, so when you see it cast, move outside the blade’s outer edge or inside its inner edge. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, immediately leave the area without hesitating over which way to go, before it pulls you in. Aatrox R World Ender increases his healing, so create distance and wait out its duration.

Akali.build: Build magic resistance first against Akali’s main damage, and get movement speed to leave the paths of her telegraphed attacks. Build enough total health to stay out of the execute range of Akali R Perfect Execution. Singed’s main magic damage is easily blocked by Akali’s high magic resistance, so include penetration in your offensive build.
Akali.combo: Before throwing Akali, check which direction she’ll go, and near an allied turret, throw her toward it. If Akali’s mobility abilities are down and it’s a favorable fight, start the engage by buffering Singed E Fling during Flash.
Akali.escape: Don’t go in just because Akali W Twilight Shroud or E Shuriken Flip is down; check for her remaining mobility abilities too. In particular, the window before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back is an opportunity to catch her with Singed E Fling. Placing Singed W Mega Adhesive first along Akali’s retreat path makes it harder for her to use a movement ability.
Akali.fight: Don’t stand still to trade basic attacks. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run past Akali to lay poison. If Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, or R Perfect Execution is available, she can escape even after being thrown, so catch her with Singed E Fling just after she uses a mobility ability. Place Singed W Mega Adhesive in the direction Akali would retreat to stop her movement.
Akali.laning: Trade back when Akali comes out of her smoke to engage or when her ultimate is unavailable, and build a lead in health and CS. Try pushing the wave and clearing the next wave from behind the turret only just after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side.
Akali.phase: After two core items, your ability to keep pushing the lane becomes strong. In the late game, your strength falls off if time passes without getting items.
Akali.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Before throwing Akali with Singed E Fling, check that the direction favors your team; if she’s on an allied carry, throw her back. Keep moving after the throw to draw several enemies around, and focus on staying alive.

TahmKench.fight: When Tahm Kench has no stacks on you, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lay poison as you pass by him. If Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down and he stays on the poison, catch him with Singed E Fling, but don’t stand still and trade basic attacks.
TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against Tahm Kench’s main damage. If duels drag on because of the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin, get an anti-healing item sooner. If you’re caught in multiple forms of crowd control, consider Quicksilver Sash.
TahmKench.combo: Check Singed’s position and the direction of the fling before throwing Tahm Kench. Near an allied turret, fling him toward the inside of the turret and overlap the adhesive.
TahmKench.escape: After Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time engaging or escaping, so look for a chance to catch him with Singed E Fling. If Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash has applied stacks, don’t engage; back off and limit his movement by placing Singed W Mega Adhesive on his escape route.
TahmKench.laning: Push the wave under Tahm Kench’s turret. Right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, clear the next wave with poison to keep Tahm Kench in lane. When the fight ends, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
TahmKench.phase: In the mid game, once you have two core items, keep pushing the lane. Make use of this window before you reach the late game without items and fall off.
TahmKench.teamfight: Keep Singed Q Poison Trail on and keep moving to disrupt the enemy formation, using the movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream to survive longer. Use Singed E Fling to send a carry Tahm Kench is protecting toward your team in a favorable direction, but if Tahm Kench R Devour is available, account for the possibility that it can protect that carry. Keep your distance from allies against the area knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, and keep moving after the fling.
TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench’s basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash have applied two stacks, move out of range and wait for them to disappear. Once you are caught by the stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or the area knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, it is easy to take follow-up hits, so manage your distance first.

Kennen.watch: Kennen stuns you after three stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm, so back away as soon as you take two hits and wait for the stacks to wear off. Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and don't stand on top of allies when engaging so you can avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom.
Kennen.build: Consider Quicksilver Sash as Singed has no ability to break a stun directly.
Kennen.combo: Check which way Kennen will go before you fling him, and keep moving with Singed Q Poison Trail on.
Kennen.escape: Right after Kennen uses E Lightning Rush, there is an opportunity to engage. Approach while placing Singed W Mega Adhesive on Kennen's retreat path, but if Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back away first to let the stacks wear off.
Kennen.fight: Close the gap immediately after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lay poison as you run past Kennen; if he stands his ground, catch him with Singed E Fling.
Kennen.laning: Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and expose yourself only briefly to last hit. After pushing the wave under Kennen's turret, go behind the turret and clear the next wave with Singed Q Poison Trail only just after the enemy jungler has been spotted on the opposite side.
Kennen.phase: After you have two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure. Don't let the late game pass by without getting items.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out so your allies aren't caught together in the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and use vision to deny Kennen an entry point. With Singed Q Poison Trail on, run through the enemy formation and gain speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream, then fling Kennen in a favorable direction with Singed E Fling. Keep moving afterward to draw out the chase.

Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain dashes in and stuns, so manage your distance first to avoid getting caught. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, you’ll be heavily slowed and targeted by Urgot W Purge, so dodge it as it flies toward you. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of range before your health reaches the execute threshold.
Urgot.build: Urgot deals primarily physical damage, and Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with your max health, so build armor first. Dead Man's Plate's armor and movement-related effects suit Singed's playstyle. Consider Quicksilver Sash to counter Urgot E Disdain's stun and the suppression from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is used, throw him with Singed E Fling, then place Singed W Mega Adhesive at his landing spot. He must land on the adhesive for the root to apply, so check which direction you want to send Urgot before flinging him. Near a turret, fling him toward the inside of its range and place the adhesive over his landing spot.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so the moment its dash and stun are used is Singed's window to engage. After Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits, its heavy slow makes it hard to walk away, so keep your distance before it hits. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get out of range before your health drops further or use Quicksilver Sash immediately.
Urgot.fight: Close the distance right after Urgot E Disdain is used, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, and pass by his side to lay poison. If Urgot does not back away, catch him with Singed E Fling; do not stand still and trade attacks. If Urgot W Purge is active, do not rely only on the slow from Singed W Mega Adhesive; walk away from the slowed Urgot to create distance.
Urgot.laning: Try pushing the wave under the enemy turret and clearing the next wave with poison right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. When the fight ends, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Urgot.phase: After two core items, constantly pushing the lane is strong, but in the late game, you fall off if time simply passes without items.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand with your frontline to reduce his engage angles. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run through the enemy team, and use Singed P Noxious Slipstream to gain movement speed before flinging an enemy carry in a favorable direction with Singed E Fling. Then keep moving, draw pursuit from multiple enemies, and survive as long as possible.

Kayle.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast and get out of areas where area damage is present. If you build resistances, get magic resistance against Kayle’s magic damage. Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces magic resistance, so you need to dodge the direct hit to preserve that value.
Kayle.watch: Dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast before closing in, since it slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so don’t fight for long when your health is low. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t pour on damage; pin her down with Singed E Fling and let the invulnerability time pass.
Kayle.combo: When fighting near Kayle's turret, first position yourself to fling her toward your allies. If you activate Singed R Insanity Potion, keep moving and leaving Singed Q Poison Trail, then turn Q off after the fight.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability to create distance, so the window just after Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses or is down is a good time to approach. Kayle can gain movement speed with Kayle W Celestial Blessing, so catch her first with Singed E Fling and place Singed W Mega Adhesive on the landing spot. Engage more aggressively if Kayle R Divine Judgment has already been used.
Kayle.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and leave poison as you run past Kayle, then if she stands her ground, fling her in a favorable direction with Singed E Fling. Don't stand still trading basic attacks.
Kayle.laning: Push the wave under Kayle's turret, and if the enemy jungler has just been spotted on the opposite side, clear the next wave from behind the turret with Singed Q Poison Trail to keep Kayle in lane. After Kayle gains ranged attack range, don't trade with her the same way; engage with your jungler.
Kayle.teamfight: Don't spend time on the front line; find a path to Kayle from the flank or out of sight. Engage in time with your allies' crowd control and fling Kayle toward them with Singed E Fling. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, hold her until the invulnerability ends. Then turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and keep moving to disrupt the enemy formation.

Olaf.build: Prioritize armor against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Get Plated Steelcaps early to withstand his basic attacks, and Dead Man’s Plate also suits Singed’s run-and-draw playstyle with its armor and movement-related interactions. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor can’t reduce, so build health and keep your distance too.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and approach, then fling Olaf in a favorable direction with Singed E Fling. Near a turret, fling him under it and place adhesive on the landing spot.
Olaf.escape: Look for an opening to approach once you've moved away from where Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands and prevented him from picking it up. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait for it to end. After R ends, Olaf has no ability to create distance himself, so engage with Singed E Fling if it's a fight you can win.
Olaf.fight: Don't stand still trading basic attacks; turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lure Olaf over the poison as you run past him. If he chases, keep moving and use the speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Use Singed E Fling in a favorable direction after Olaf R Ragnarok ends.
Olaf.laning: Don't fight Olaf head-on early; move in the opposite direction from where Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. Push the wave under the enemy turret to keep Olaf in lane. When clearing the next wave from behind the turret, do it just after the enemy jungler has been spotted on the opposite side.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so don't give him a kill and stall for time. After two core items, Singed becomes stronger at continuously pushing the lane, while Olaf gets relatively weaker as the game goes on.
Olaf.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy formation, using the movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Don't hit Olaf with Singed E Fling during Olaf R Ragnarok; create distance. After R ends, if Olaf is on your allied damage dealers, fling him in a favorable direction and keep moving instead of staying there.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, so move opposite the direction where the axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. During Olaf R Ragnarok, Singed W Mega Adhesive's movement impairment won't work, and hitting him with Singed E Fling extends its duration, so create distance and use E after it ends. Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal at low health, and Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so don't stand and fight him just because he's at half health.

Quinn.phase: In the mid game, once you have two core items, keep pushing the lane as Singed. In the late game, don’t let time pass without getting items.
Quinn.build: Quinn's damage is heavily physical, so build armor first. Get Plated Steelcaps early to withstand her basic attack poke, and consider Dead Man's Plate for its armor and movement-related effects.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, use Singed E Fling to throw her backward. Before you fling her, check that the direction she'll land is favorable.
Quinn.escape: The moment after Quinn E Vault is down is your window to engage while she has no escape. Close the gap then and use Singed E Fling, placing Singed W Mega Adhesive along Quinn's retreat path.
Quinn.fight: Early on, survive in Quinn's range and trade right after Quinn E Vault is down. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run past Quinn to leave poison, and catch her with Singed E Fling if she doesn't retreat. Don't stand still trading basic attacks.
Quinn.laning: Preserve your health and collect CS early, farming while Quinn P Harrier's mark isn't on you. Don't look for an angle to engage Quinn alone without jungle help. If you want to push the wave and clear the next one behind her turret, move in right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side.
Quinn.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. If Quinn approaches from the side, use Singed E Fling to throw her toward your team, then keep moving.
Quinn.watch: If Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of basic attack range before she can hit you with the empowered attack. Quinn E Vault interrupts Singed's approach and moves her backward, so don't force an engage while her E is available. Avoid Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind the minion line.

Sett.combo: Before you fling Sett, check whether he’ll land in a favorable position behind Singed. Near a turret, fling Sett under it and overlap adhesive on his landing spot.
Sett.build: Sett's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Get Plated Steelcaps early to withstand basic attacks, and consider Dead Man's Plate for its armor and movement-related effects. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't focus too heavily on stacking health.
Sett.escape: Before engaging, avoid a setup that lets Sett E Facebreaker catch enemies on both sides of Sett. If Sett R The Show Stopper is available, Singed's abilities alone can't help you escape, so manage your distance first.
Sett.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run past Sett to leave poison, and reposition him with Singed E Fling if he holds his ground. After dealing damage, briefly create distance and wait for Sett's grit from Sett W Haymaker to cool down.
Sett.laning: Push the wave into Sett's turret, and right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, clear the next wave behind the turret with poison to keep Sett in lane. Turn off Singed Q Poison Trail after a fight to save mana.
Sett.phase: After you have two core items, keep pushing the lane to hold Sett there, and don't let the late game pass without items.
Sett.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Avoid positions where Sett E Facebreaker can stun you, and use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team. Don't stand and fight where you fling them; keep moving so multiple enemies chase you.
Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of him, so avoid positioning with Sett between you and minions or allies. Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after Sett takes damage, so create distance; when he activates it, move sideways out of the center of its indicator. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, and Flash cannot break it, so watch where you will be thrown while Sett has R available.

Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Rather than only increasing armor or health, also get movement speed to leave the area telegraphed for Aurora’s area attacks.
Aurora.combo: If you’ve read the path Aurora will take to retreat with a mobility ability, place Singed W Mega Adhesive there to block it. Near an allied turret, throw her into its range and layer adhesive to extend the time it takes her to escape.
Aurora.escape: The window to go in is after Aurora has used both W Across the Veil and E The Weirding. If she becomes invisible with Aurora W Across the Veil, don’t rush to use Singed E Fling; place Singed W Mega Adhesive at her expected movement point and wait for her to reappear.
Aurora.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run past Aurora to lay poison, then catch her with Singed E Fling if she holds her ground. If Aurora W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, or R Between Worlds is available, she can escape even after being thrown, so look for the moment just after she uses a mobility ability. Against healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, use the healing reduction applied to poison while Singed R Insanity Potion is active.
Aurora.laning: Push the wave under the enemy turret and clear the next wave with poison to keep Aurora tied to the lane, but go behind the turret only just after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. After the fight, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Aurora.phase: In the mid game, after two core items, continuously pushing the lane is strong. In the late game, Singed’s strength falls off if time passes without getting items.
Aurora.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing the movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream. If Aurora jumps in but can’t contribute to a kill, look to use Singed E Fling in a favorable direction while her mobility ability is down. After throwing her, keep moving instead of stopping to fight, and make sure no low-health allies are left behind when you retreat.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when the curse is recalled, and becomes more dangerous as missing health increases. If you’re cursed, move out of the straight line between you and Aurora, and if health is low, retreat before it is recalled. When Aurora R Between Worlds appears, leaving the zone slows you, so decide whether to create distance before it appears.

Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage, and buy Plated Steelcaps earlier to withstand her basic attacks. Dead Man's Plate provides armor and movement-related effects that suit luring Camille around while you keep running. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage can’t be reduced by armor, and stacking only health also increases the damage from Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Camille.combo: Use Singed W Mega Adhesive to block Camille’s escape path too. Near a turret, throw Camille into its range and place adhesive at her landing point.
Camille.escape: The moment after Camille E Hookshot is used to clear a wave or elsewhere is an opportunity to engage. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is also down and hasn’t come back yet, she’ll have a hard time escaping after Singed E Fling. If Camille still has a mobility ability, she can escape even after being thrown, so check whether she’s used it first.
Camille.fight: Avoid fighting right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield.
Camille.laning: Before the first core item, push the wave to keep Camille, who clears lanes slowly, tied to the lane. If the enemy jungler has just been spotted on the opposite side, you can go behind the turret and clear the next wave with Singed Q Poison Trail. Stand among the minions and away from walls to limit Camille E Hookshot’s engage angles.
Camille.phase: Camille is weak before her first core item, but from the mid game onward she can quickly destroy turrets if you leave her alone in a side lane, so don’t leave the lane unattended.
Camille.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy formation, using Singed P Noxious Slipstream’s movement speed as you pass between champions. If Camille is on an allied carry, use Singed E Fling to peel her off, but check your direction so you don’t throw Camille from the middle of your team to safety. Keep moving after the throw instead of staying in place, and draw several enemies into chasing you.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot can use a wall to dash in from a distance and stun you, so stand away from walls. If you’re trapped by Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, don’t use a response ability as she engages; endure its duration.

Chogath.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Resistance doesn’t work against the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, but E Vorpal Spikes scales with maximum health, so avoid only stacking health too. Consider tenacity if you often take follow-up hits after knockups and silences.
Chogath.combo: When Cho'Gath Q Rupture is down, use Singed E Fling to throw Cho'Gath back. Near a turret, first line up the direction to throw him into its range.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility abilities, so when engaging, look for the moment right after Cho'Gath Q Rupture is used on the wave or misses. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, walk out of its frontal area before trying to use an ability. Don’t go back in while Cho'Gath R Feast is a threat at your current health.
Chogath.fight: Approach after Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses or is used on the wave. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run past Cho'Gath to lay poison, then throw him in a favorable direction with Singed E Fling if he holds his ground. In fights where healing from Cho'Gath P Carnivore is a concern, activate Singed R Insanity Potion to apply healing reduction to your poison.
Chogath.laning: Push the lane from the start to limit Cho'Gath’s time to scale. If the enemy jungler has just been spotted on the opposite side, push the wave under the turret, then go behind it and clear the next wave with poison to keep Cho'Gath tied to the lane.
Chogath.phase: After two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure, but manage your health so Cho'Gath, who gets stronger over time, doesn’t kill you in the late game.
Chogath.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, increasing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team, then keep moving to draw the enemy’s chase instead of stopping to fight. When your health is low, keep your distance because Cho'Gath R Feast deals true damage and has increased range.
Chogath.watch: When the warning appears beneath you for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, immediately move to the side to dodge the knockup. If you’re hit by the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, it’s hard to dodge the follow-up Q Rupture, so don’t start a trade head-on. If your health is at or below half, retreat outside the range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius’s main damage. Buy Plated Steelcaps earlier and consider Dead Man's Plate for its armor and movement-related interactions. Darius E Apprehend’s penetration cuts through some armor, and resistance can’t reduce the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine, so build total health too.
Darius.combo: During the window when Darius E Apprehend is down, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, approach, and throw him with Singed E Fling. Near a turret, throw him into its range and layer W afterward.
Darius.escape: The window to go in is when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Place Singed W Mega Adhesive along Darius’s retreat path, and create distance once Darius P Hemorrhage stacks start building up.
Darius.fight: Take a short trade just after Darius E Apprehend misses or Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run past him to lay poison, then change his position with Singed E Fling if he holds his ground. Don’t fight in place for long and allow stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage or healing from Darius Q Decimate.
Darius.laning: Early on, keep Darius tied to the lane rather than fighting him for long. Try pushing the wave under the enemy turret and clearing the next wave with poison only just after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. After the trade, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Darius.phase: After two core items, keep pushing the lane and drawing the enemy around. In the late game, don’t let your strength fall off by spending time without getting items.
Darius.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run across the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. When the direction is favorable, throw an enemy carry toward your team with Singed E Fling, then keep moving. Use poison while Singed R Insanity Potion is active to reduce healing from Darius Q Decimate, but don’t stay within range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine while Darius P Hemorrhage stacks are on you.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, Darius W Crippling Strike and Darius Q Decimate follow, so move outside its range and approach after E misses. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or hug him to reduce his healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance and don’t stay within range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine while carrying several stacks.

DrMundo.build: Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma is his main source of damage, so build armor first. If healing makes a duel drag on, you need healing reduction; you can apply it with Singed Q Poison Trail while Singed R Insanity Potion is active.
DrMundo.combo: Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t rely on Singed E Fling while his passive is available. Near a turret, line up the direction to throw Mundo into its range.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, you have an opportunity to engage with Singed E Fling. If Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by a minion or misses, you can approach while avoiding its slow.
DrMundo.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run past Dr. Mundo to leave poison. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and he doesn’t retreat, use Singed E Fling to change his position. Don’t chase for long while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.laning: After a damage trade, if Dr. Mundo has dropped a canister, step on it along your retreat path to deny his healing and the passive cooldown reduction. Try pushing the wave and clearing the next wave from behind the turret only just after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side.
DrMundo.phase: Singed is strong at continuously pushing the lane after two core items. In the late game, his strength falls off if time passes without getting items.
DrMundo.teamfight: With Singed Q Poison Trail on, move through the enemy team and refresh your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Rather than chasing Dr. Mundo for a long time while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, throw an enemy carry toward your team with Singed E Fling in a favorable direction. Keep moving after the throw to make several enemies chase you.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target it reaches and provides a slow and healing. Dodge it with minions between you, and don’t stand still trading while taking the empowered basic attacks from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so don’t spend time trying to kill him.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework, and consider Plated Steelcaps and Dead Man's Plate. True damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and R Grand Challenge can’t be reduced by armor, and she also deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about only stacking health.
Fiora.combo: Bait out Fiora W Riposte first, then look to use Singed E Fling just after she uses Fiora Q Lunge. Before throwing her, check that the direction favors you.
Fiora.escape: The moment after Fiora Q Lunge is down is an opportunity for Singed to go in and land Singed E Fling. If Fiora W Riposte is available, she can block the throw and stun you, so look for a window when Riposte is down too. Place Singed W Mega Adhesive along Fiora’s retreat path to prevent her from using a movement ability.
Fiora.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run past Fiora to lay poison, and keep moving. If she holds her ground, catch her with Singed E Fling, but when Fiora W Riposte is available, bait out Riposte first and move to the side to avoid its counter-thrust hit. The moment after Fiora Q Lunge is used is a good time to close the distance and throw her.
Fiora.laning: Push the wave to keep Fiora tied to the lane, and go behind the turret to clear the next wave only just after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. After briefly applying poison, don’t chase Fiora recklessly.
Fiora.teamfight: With Singed Q Poison Trail on, run through the enemy team and keep moving using the movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream. After seeing that Fiora W Riposte is down, use Singed E Fling in a favorable direction, and don’t stay where you threw her. If you’re hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals.
Fiora.watch: Watch Fiora Q Lunge for movements toward your vital and stand opposite the vital to narrow her angle. If you’re hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall to block the vital on one side.

Gangplank.build: Build armor early, before Gangplank Q Parrrley poke adds up. Dead Man's Plate suits Singed’s playstyle with its armor and movement effects. Health also matters against the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.combo: Check which way you’ll throw Gangplank before using Fling. If you’re near an allied tower, throw him toward the inside of its range.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for an opening when Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down and Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed. If a primed E Powder Keg is nearby, back away instead of entering through its slow.
Gangplank.fight: When Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed and isn’t primed yet, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and pass nearby to trade. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, catch him with Singed E Fling. In trades where the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is a problem, activate Singed R Insanity Potion and lead him over your poison.
Gangplank.laning: Early on, trade while moving with Singed Q Poison Trail instead of standing still to fight. Turn Q off after the trade to save mana. After pushing the wave under the enemy tower, if the enemy jungler was spotted on the other side of the map, clear the next wave with poison to keep Gangplank in lane.
Gangplank.phase: After completing two core items, constantly pushing the lane is strong, but Singed falls off in the late game if time passes without items.
Gangplank.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, check your throw direction and use Singed E Fling to send him toward your team. Keep moving instead of stopping to fight there, and make the enemy chase you.
Gangplank.watch: If Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, back away and don’t enter the area where two kegs overlap.

Garen.build: Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment deal his main physical damage, so build armor first. Plated Steelcaps help you withstand his empowered attacks, and Dead Man's Plate provides armor and movement effects. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage that armor can’t reduce, so consider health as well.
Garen.combo: Before throwing Garen, check where behind Singed he’ll land. If Garen activates Garen W Courage, wait for its brief shield and tenacity to pass, then use Singed E Fling.
Garen.escape: Once the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike has been spent, you have an opportunity to engage without worrying about its silence. Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so use Singed E Fling to engage when you have an angle to catch him. However, if health is below half, stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice’s range.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly just after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack is used on a minion or otherwise spent. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and pass by Garen to lay poison, then catch him with Singed E Fling if he holds his ground. Keep moving instead of standing still to fight inside Garen E Judgment.
Garen.phase: Take advantage of the period after completing two core items to keep pushing the lane, but Garen gets stronger as his growth stacks accumulate, so the matchup becomes less favorable over time.
Garen.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, passing through champions to keep Singed P Noxious Slipstream’s movement speed boost going. Throw an enemy damage dealer toward your team with Singed E Fling, then keep moving instead of staying there. Make several enemies chase Singed and survive as long as possible to disrupt their formation.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack silences, so don’t engage while it’s active. Staying close to Garen E Judgment for too long is disadvantageous, so move out of its spin range. Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity right after activation, so delay Singed E Fling by half a beat. If health drops below half, watch out for Garen R Demacian Justice and stay out of its range.

Gnar.build: Gnar’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If his basic attack poke is a problem, get Plated Steelcaps earlier. Dead Man's Plate provides armor and suits Singed’s pattern of engaging and then staying in motion. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Gnar.combo: When Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and approach. Turn Q off after the trade to save mana.
Gnar.escape: Gnar E Hop / Crunch is his mobility, so engage right after you force him to use it. If Mega Gnar still has Gnar R GNAR!, approach while avoiding angles that could knock you into a wall. Create distance and run out the clock just after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar.
Gnar.fight: Fight just after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar, during the period when he can’t transform again. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and pass by Gnar to lay poison, but don’t stand still trading basic attacks. Right after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used, you have an opportunity to catch him with Singed E Fling.
Gnar.laning: If Mini Gnar’s poke is too much, farm near your tower and watch his transformation cycle. Try pushing the wave and clearing the next one behind the tower right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the other side of the map.
Gnar.phase: After completing two core items, constantly pushing the lane is strong, but Singed falls off in the late game if time passes without items.
Gnar.teamfight: Use the moment Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar as an opportunity to enter a teamfight, and avoid narrow terrain where Gnar R GNAR! could knock you into a wall. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Throw an enemy damage dealer in a favorable direction with Singed E Fling, then keep moving and make the enemy chase you.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows, so sidestep the boomerang’s path. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so avoid fighting with your back to one. As his transformation approaches, create distance instead of facing him head-on.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen Q Snip Snip! Also get some armor against her basic attack physical damage, but avoid stacking only health because she deals damage based on maximum health. You must dodge the true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by positioning; resistances can’t block it.
Gwen.combo: When Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down and you can target her from outside Gwen W Hallowed Mist, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and approach. If you’re near a tower, position your throw to send her toward the inside of its range.
Gwen.escape: Right after making Gwen use E Skip 'n Slash, you have an opportunity to engage with Singed E Fling. Place Singed W Mega Adhesive along Gwen’s retreat path to prevent her from using movement abilities. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don’t use Singed E Fling from outside the mist.
Gwen.fight: Move outside Gwen’s basic attack range to deny healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and pass by Gwen to lay poison. Close the distance right after Gwen uses E Skip 'n Slash and look for Singed E Fling. Don’t fight up close if Gwen Q Snip Snip! has full stacks.
Gwen.laning: After pushing the wave under the enemy tower, try clearing the next wave with poison right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the other side of the map. Turn off Singed Q Poison Trail after the trade to save mana.
Gwen.phase: After completing two core items, constantly pushing the lane is strong, but Singed falls off in the late game if time passes without items.
Gwen.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and keep moving between champions to use Singed P Noxious Slipstream’s movement speed. Dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and if Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, check whether she’s targetable before using Singed E Fling to throw her in a favorable direction. Keep moving after the throw to disrupt the enemy formation.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s cone deals true damage, so sidestep instead of standing in front of it. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target her with Singed E Fling from outside the mist, so enter it or wait until it ends. Also watch out for the slow and maximum-health-based damage from Gwen R Needlework.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi’s main damage is physical, so build armor first and consider Dead Man's Plate, which suits a playstyle based on moving and controlling distance. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t stack only health. If you’re looking to dive, get healing reduction early with Executioner's Calling.
Illaoi.combo: Throw Illaoi with Singed E Fling after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down.
Illaoi.escape: Right after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson, you have an opportunity to engage with Singed E Fling. If you also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, the risk of being caught is lower. If Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, don’t fight there; spread out and wait out its duration.
Illaoi.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and pass by Illaoi to lay poison. If she holds her ground instead of backing away, reposition her with Singed E Fling, but don’t stand still trading damage. While Singed R Insanity Potion is active, your poison applies healing reduction, so lead Illaoi over it.
Illaoi.phase: In the mid game, after completing two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure. Be wary of the late game if time passes without items.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t fight near Illaoi’s tentacles; if you can’t destroy them, draw her away from the wall. Spread out when she uses R Leap of Faith. Keep moving with Singed Q Poison Trail to disrupt the formation, and use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy damage dealer in a favorable direction.
Illaoi.watch: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, and if you’re hit, fight back when you can. When Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, don’t fight near the tentacles; spread out and wait out its duration.

Irelia.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Basic attacks and attack speed are also key parts of her damage, so an item that reduces attack speed helps.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, use Singed E Fling to throw her in a favorable direction.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge to clear the wave, you have an opportunity to engage. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, the risk of being held by its stun is lower, so engage with Singed E Fling.
Irelia.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, pass by Irelia to lay poison, and keep moving. If you catch her with Singed E Fling right after she uses Q Bladesurge, it will be difficult for her to escape immediately.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia. Push the wave, then clear the next one behind the tower right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the other side of the map.
Irelia.phase: After completing two core items, constantly pushing the lane is strong, but Singed falls off in the late game if time passes without items.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia can split the formation with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and stun multiple enemies with Irelia E Flawless Duet, so prioritize harassing her. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the formation. Catch Irelia with Singed E Fling when throwing her toward your team is favorable. Keep moving after the throw instead of standing still to fight, and draw the enemy into chasing you.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain approaches by dashing to low-health minions, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Dodge Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun, and if you’re caught inside the zone from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: First consider an option that reduces Jax’s attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Jax E Counter Strike also deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Jax.combo: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and keep moving. If Jax Q Leap Strike is down, use Singed E Fling to throw him behind you. Turn off Singed Q Poison Trail after the trade to save mana.
Jax.escape: Right after making Jax use Q Leap Strike, you have an opportunity to engage with Singed E Fling. If Jax E Counter Strike is also down, trade during the window when you don’t need to worry about its stun. While Counter Strike is active, wait outside its range for the duration to end.
Jax.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and pass by Jax, leading him along the poisoned path. While Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t fight back with basic attacks; move outside its stun range. Trade by repositioning Jax with Singed E Fling after Jax Q Leap Strike or Jax E Counter Strike is down.
Jax.laning: Push the wave and clear the next one behind the tower right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the other side of the map.
Jax.phase: After completing two core items, Singed is strong when constantly pushing the lane, but he falls off in the late game if time passes without items.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax leaps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group with your team; after the area stun ends, use Singed E Fling to remove him in a favorable direction. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, gaining movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream, and look for an opportunity to throw an enemy damage dealer toward your team. Keep moving after the throw instead of standing still to fight.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move outside its area of effect stun range. Jax can engage with Jax Q Leap Strike, so block his path with Singed W Mega Adhesive or manage your distance after he uses the leap.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against Jayce’s main damage. However, it won’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer reduces resistances, so also get movement speed to dodge telegraphed attacks.
Jayce.combo: After Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down, use Singed E Fling to throw him in a favorable direction.
Jayce.escape: Right after Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down, there’s an opening to engage. Against Jayce with his hammer, you can reduce the risk of being knocked back by checking for Jayce E Thundering Blow before approaching.
Jayce.fight: Close the distance right after Jayce uses Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and pass by Jayce to lay poison, then catch him with Singed E Fling if he doesn’t back away. Don’t stand still trading basic attacks.
Jayce.laning: While Jayce is strong early, farm while moving side to side instead of forcing trades. If health has been reduced, clear the lane and return. After pushing the wave under the enemy tower, go behind it to clear the next wave with Singed Q Poison Trail only when the enemy jungler has been spotted on the other side of the map.
Jayce.phase: Make use of the window for continuously pushing the lane after completing two core items, but don’t let time pass into the late game without items.
Jayce.teamfight: Watch for the moment Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, then approach. With Singed Q Poison Trail active, run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream, and look for an opportunity to throw Jayce toward your team. Keep moving after the throw to draw the enemy into chasing you.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce E Acceleration Gate is placed, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of its line. Farm while moving side to side against Jayce with his cannon, and watch out for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow when he has his hammer.

Kled.build: Kled's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Getting Plated Steelcaps early helps you withstand Kled W Violent Tendencies attacks, and Dead Man's Plate suits Singed's movement-focused play while adding armor. Tenacity is also worth considering because being locked down by crowd control is dangerous.
Kled.combo: Check your position and which way Kled will go before you fling him. Near a turret, fling him under it and overlap adhesive to slow his escape.
Kled.escape: Avoid the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and look to engage after Kled E Jousting is down. If Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is available, he can escape with another means of movement, so use Singed E Fling in a window when R is unavailable too. If it's a fight you can win, you can buffer Singed E Fling during Flash to fling him as soon as you arrive.
Kled.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lay poison as you run past Kled; don't stand still trading basic attacks. It's best to catch Kled with Singed E Fling after Kled E Jousting is down and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is unavailable. After the fight, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Kled.laning: After knocking Kled off Skaarl, push Kled out of lane so he can't build Courage by killing minions. Try pushing and clearing the next wave from behind the turret only just after the enemy jungler has been spotted on the opposite side.
Kled.phase: From the mid game, once you have two core items, Singed becomes much stronger at continuously pushing the lane. Keep farming too, since you fall off if time passes in the late game without items.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks because Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can start from out of sight. If you can't stop his engage in advance, keep a formation where your front line takes the initial charge. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run through the enemy team, gain speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream, then fling an enemy damage dealer in a favorable direction with Singed E Fling and keep moving.
Kled.watch: If you get hit by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, immediately create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off before taking the fourth attack, which deals damage based on your max health, then re-engage. Kled can follow up with Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, so don't relax just because one mobility ability is down.

KSante.build: Build armor first against K'Sante's main damage, and consider Dead Man's Plate for its armor and movement benefits. K'Sante has several forms of immobilizing crowd control, so also get Quicksilver Sash to break free from them.
KSante.combo: Position yourself so you can fling K'Sante in a favorable direction, then use Singed E Fling first.
KSante.escape: Don't go in just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down; check whether K'Sante E Footwork and R All Out are available too. Look to engage with Singed E Fling in the window when both W and E are down, especially before K'Sante R All Out comes back up.
KSante.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lay poison as you run past K'Sante; don't stand still and fight him. After K'Sante W Path Maker and E Footwork are down, catch him with Singed E Fling, especially when K'Sante R All Out is also down.
KSante.laning: After pushing the wave under the enemy turret, clear the next wave with poison to keep K'Sante in lane only if the enemy jungler has been spotted on the opposite side.
KSante.phase: In the mid game, once you have two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure. Don't let the late game pass by without getting items.
KSante.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Don't spend crowd control while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging; sidestep the charge. When K'Sante R All Out is active and he becomes less durable, focus your damage with your team and keep moving while applying Grievous Wounds with poison empowered by Singed R Insanity Potion.
KSante.watch: If K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes hits you repeatedly, watch for the pull and stun on his next Q and back out of range. When you see K'Sante W Path Maker charging, sidestep it, and check the terrain behind you so K'Sante R All Out can't knock you over a wall.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against Malphite's main damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Magic resistance won't block Malphite W Thunderclap's damage, and movement speed is also important for getting out of telegraphed areas.
Malphite.combo: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and keep moving to break Malphite P Granite Shield, then fling Malphite behind you with Singed E Fling.
Malphite.escape: The window to engage is while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. If you use Singed E Fling then, Malphite can't escape with his ultimate. Delay your engage if you've just been slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard.
Malphite.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and leave poison as you run past Malphite to break Malphite P Granite Shield first. If Malphite holds his ground, catch him with Singed E Fling, but don't start a fight right after being slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard.
Malphite.laning: Use poison to prevent Malphite P Granite Shield from coming back, and don't stay within Malphite Q Seismic Shard range for long. Try pushing and clearing the next wave from behind the turret only just after the enemy jungler has been spotted on the opposite side.
Malphite.phase: Singed has relatively low health growth in the late game, so don't let time pass without getting items.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies before engaging so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn't knock up several of you, and don't group up when you can't see Malphite. Counterengage just after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, and run through the enemy formation. Refresh your speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream, fling an enemy damage dealer in a favorable direction, then keep moving to draw out the chase.
Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so don't start a trade immediately afterward. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't be stopped even by Singed W Mega Adhesive, so when you can't see him, don't give him an engage angle near a bush or wall.

Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first against Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, and Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Also get armor against his empowered basic attacks, but don't rely on stacking health alone given the penetration on Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and max-health-based damage from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Mordekaiser.combo: After Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and approach, then use Singed E Fling to throw Mordekaiser behind you into a favorable spot. Near a turret, fling him under it and slow his way out with Singed W Mega Adhesive.
Mordekaiser.escape: The moment after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses is a window to go in with less risk of being pulled. Mordekaiser has no ability to create distance, so catch him with Singed E Fling if you can throw him in a favorable direction. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone even if that window appears.
Mordekaiser.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and make a short trade as you run past Mordekaiser, then back away before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Engage with Singed E Fling after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, when you can catch him and fling him to a favorable position. Don't pour in damage just after Mordekaiser W Indestructible activates; wait until the shield has worn down or been converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Push the wave to keep Mordekaiser in lane, and go behind his turret to clear the next wave only just after the enemy jungler has been spotted on the opposite side. After the fight, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Mordekaiser.phase: The period after getting two core items is a strong macro window for Singed, but he falls off if time passes in the late game without items.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out in front of Mordekaiser so he can't pull several allies at once with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run through the formation, gain speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream, and fling an enemy damage dealer toward your allies with Singed E Fling. Don't stand there and fight; keep moving, and if Mordekaiser chases you, slow him with Singed W Mega Adhesive and keep your distance.
Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, Mordekaiser can easily hit Mordekaiser Q Obliterate too and activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, so keep your distance in front of him. When Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, staying close is a losing trade; slow him with Singed W Mega Adhesive and retreat. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone to avoid a duel where your allies can't help.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus's main damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor in the area it covers, so don't stay on it.
Nasus.combo: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and keep moving to create a path for Nasus to walk through the poison. After the fight, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no way to create distance by himself besides Flash, so engage when you've forced him to use Flash or he can't use it. After Nasus W Wither is down, there's less risk of being caught by its slow, so engage with Singed E Fling. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, pass up even that opportunity unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.fight: If Nasus holds his ground, catch him with E Fling, but don't fight while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Let the lane push toward you and pressure the spot where Nasus stacks Nasus Q Siphoning Strike with last hits. Don't keep giving him the chance to safely stack under his turret after you push the wave in. Nasus has no escape tool besides Flash, so pulling the lane and calling for a jungle gank is also good.
Nasus.phase: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks up over time and makes the matchup harder, so slow his scaling early.
Nasus.teamfight: Don't face Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance and wait out its duration. Keep moving with Singed Q Poison Trail on, and use the movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream to disrupt the enemy formation. Use Singed E Fling when the position after the throw will favor your allies, and keep moving after the throw.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more threatening as it stacks, so pressure him from the start to make last hitting difficult. Nasus W Wither makes it hard to escape, so don't move alone within its range. Nasus R Fury of the Sands makes him stronger, so unless you have a clear advantage, avoid fighting and wait out its duration.

Ornn.build: Consider tenacity first because Ornn's crowd control from Ornn W Bellows Breath into Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God is dangerous. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don't focus your resistances on just one type.
Ornn.combo: Before you fling Ornn, check which direction he will land. If you're near an allied turret, fling him toward its inner side and place adhesive there.
Ornn.escape: The moment after Ornn uses Ornn E Searing Charge to clear the wave or for another purpose is your chance to engage. Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God if it's still available, so look for a window to use Singed E Fling when his R is also down and before it comes back up. Ornn's crowd control can make it easy to get hit by follow-up attacks, so stay clear of pillars and walls before you engage.
Ornn.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run past Ornn to leave poison, and keep moving. If Ornn holds his ground, catch him with Singed E Fling, but first check whether he can escape with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Don't stand still trading basic attacks.
Ornn.laning: If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, stay on him and interrupt the process. Only try to push the wave and clear the next one behind his turret right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side.
Ornn.phase: In the late game, Singed falls off if time passes without items, so apply pressure before Ornn's items and your team's Masterwork upgrades stack up.
Ornn.teamfight: Keep moving with Singed Q Poison Trail on, using Singed P Noxious Slipstream for speed, and fling an enemy carry toward your team with Singed E Fling when the angle is favorable. Avoid the line between Ornn and the spirit summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and watch for the path along which Ornn redirects the spirit after it passes. After the fling, keep moving instead of staying in place to draw out the enemy's chase.
Ornn.watch: Stay away from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture's pillar and nearby walls. Ornn E Searing Charge knocks you up if it hits the pillar or a wall, so when you see him wind up, retreat toward open ground. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, don't move forward; keep your distance until the effect ends.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Dead Man's Plate fits Singed's run-and-fight style, and get Plated Steelcaps early if you need to withstand basic attacks. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Pantheon.combo: First check the direction Pantheon will be flung and where he will land, then use Singed E Fling to throw him backward and immediately place Singed W Mega Adhesive there. If he lands on the adhesive, he is rooted, and it can also prevent him from using movement abilities. Near a turret, fling him toward its inner side and place Singed W Mega Adhesive to extend the time he needs to escape.
Pantheon.escape: Engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and the risk of being stunned is lower. Check whether Pantheon can still use Pantheon R Grand Starfall, and especially look for a chance to use Singed E Fling before his R comes back up. Only in a fight you can win, buffer Singed E Fling during Flash to fling him as soon as you arrive.
Pantheon.fight: If Pantheon holds his ground, catch him with Singed E Fling, but if Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait before attacking from the front or change your angle. Singed's magic damage is effective against Pantheon.
Pantheon.laning: Early on, avoid giving Pantheon a kill and buy time. Stay behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke. After pushing the wave, if the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, clear the next wave behind the turret with Singed Q Poison Trail to keep Pantheon in lane. Turn off Singed Q Poison Trail after a fight to save mana.
Pantheon.phase: After you have two core items, continually pushing the lane is strong, while Pantheon's influence falls off as the game goes on.
Pantheon.teamfight: If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front, wait for it to end or circle around to the side. When the direction is favorable, use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team. Keep moving after the fling to make the enemy chase you.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so don't give him range. Stay behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don't attack from the front; wait for it to end or circle around to the side.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health. Buy Quicksilver Sash to prepare for being caught by Poppy's repeated immobilizing crowd control.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, check the direction and use Singed E Fling to throw her backward. Near an allied turret, fling her toward its inner side and overlap Singed W Mega Adhesive there.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap and land Singed E Fling. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait for its short duration to end; if she charges Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move out of her front and create distance. Singed has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your distance while Poppy still has crowd control available.
Poppy.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run past Poppy to leave poison, and keep moving. Even if Poppy holds her ground, she can escape after Singed E Fling with Poppy E Heroic Charge if her E is available, so look for an opening right after she uses Poppy E Heroic Charge. If she activates Poppy W Steadfast Presence, wait for it to end or walk up to her.
Poppy.laning: Push the wave into Poppy's turret to keep her in lane, and if the enemy jungler has just been spotted on the opposite side, clear the next wave behind the turret with poison. If Poppy's shield drops, step on it before she can to deny her the shield.
Poppy.phase: After you have two core items, continually pushing the lane is strong, but Singed falls off if the late game passes without items.
Poppy.teamfight: With Singed Q Poison Trail on, run through the enemy team, passing between champions to refresh Singed P Noxious Slipstream's movement speed. Once you confirm a favorable direction, use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team. Don't stay where you fling them; keep moving to draw multiple enemies into chasing you.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns if it hits a wall, so don't position with a wall or narrow passage behind you; stay in open ground. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock's first hit lands, immediately walk out of the remaining area to avoid the second hit. When Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper's Verdict and spins her hammer, move to the side instead of staying in front of her.

Renekton.build: Renekton's main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice is physical, so build armor first. Dead Man's Plate gives armor and movement-related effects that suit Singed's playstyle, but empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so first position yourself to avoid that dash.
Renekton.combo: After Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, use Singed E Fling to throw him backward.
Renekton.escape: The moment after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to escape is your window to engage. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down, catch him with Singed E Fling and place Singed W Mega Adhesive along his retreat path to stop him escaping with a dash.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton's Fury bar is empty or immediately after he has used all of Q, W, and E. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run past him to leave poison, and catch him with Singed E Fling if he holds his ground. Don't stand still trading basic attacks.
Renekton.laning: Poke Renekton when he steps toward the minions to build Fury. Only push the wave and clear the next one behind his turret with poison right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side.
Renekton.phase: Renekton's value falls off from the mid game onward. Singed is strong at continually pushing the lane once he has two core items, but falls off if the late game arrives without items.
Renekton.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Use Singed E Fling when you can throw an enemy carry toward your team, then keep moving to draw multiple enemies into chasing you. While Singed R Insanity Potion is active, your poison applies Grievous Wounds, helping you deal with healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek.
Renekton.watch: If Renekton P Reign of Anger is above half or close enough to fill with one basic attack, stay out of range to avoid the stun from an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions to enable a second dash, so don't stand in or behind a group of minions.

Riven.build: Riven's damage is physical, so build armor first. You can get Plated Steelcaps early to withstand basic attacks, and Dead Man's Plate also suits Singed's playstyle with its armor and movement-related effects.
Riven.combo: Before you fling Riven, check whether she will land in a favorable position behind you. Near a turret, fling her toward its inner side and overlap Singed W Mega Adhesive at the landing spot.
Riven.escape: Look for a chance to engage when Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear the wave. Riven E Valor is also a mobility tool, so don't force an engage just because one ability is down. If Riven engages first, don't use your crowd control early; counter with Singed E Fling.
Riven.fight: The moment after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions is your chance to trade. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run past her to leave poison, but don't stand still trading basic attacks. If Riven closes in and starts her combo, use Singed E Fling to reposition her and interrupt her follow-up attacks.
Riven.laning: After pushing the wave in, try clearing the next wave behind the turret right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. Turn off Singed Q Poison Trail after a fight to save mana.
Riven.phase: In the mid game, once you have two core items, keep moving while pushing the lane. Keep in mind that Singed falls off if time passes in the late game without items.
Riven.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, passing between champions to use Singed P Noxious Slipstream's movement speed. If Riven dives your allied carry, use Singed E Fling to throw her backward, then keep moving instead of staying in place.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are dashes, and Riven Q Broken Wings also knocks you up, making it easy to get hit by successive attacks if she catches you once.

Rumble.build: Prioritize a defensive item with magic resistance. Rumble E Electro Harpoon reduces magic resistance, but magic resistance is the resistance to build against Rumble's damage. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid builds that stack only health.
Rumble.combo: Move with Singed Q Poison Trail on, then use Singed E Fling to throw Rumble backward. Before you fling him, check the direction he'll land; near a turret, fling him toward its inner side.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so engage after Rumble W Scrap Shield's movement speed bonus ends and he uses Rumble E Electro Harpoon. If the first harpoon hits you, don't stand your ground and engage; first create enough distance to dodge the second harpoon. If it's a fight you can win, you can buffer Singed E Fling during Flash to catch him immediately.
Rumble.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run past Rumble to leave poison, making him walk forward if he wants to continue trading. Immediately after Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, wait for its shield and movement speed bonus to pass. If Rumble holds his ground, catch him with Singed E Fling and keep moving so you don't stay in Rumble Q Flamespitter for long.
Rumble.laning: Push the wave in to keep Rumble in lane, and right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, clear the next wave behind the turret with poison. Turn off Singed Q Poison Trail after a fight to save mana.
Rumble.phase: After you have two core items, continually pushing the lane becomes strong, but Singed falls off if the late game passes without items.
Rumble.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, passing between champions to refresh Singed P Noxious Slipstream's movement speed bonus. Keep moving so you aren't held in the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer for long, and use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team when the angle is favorable. Don't stay where you fling them; keep dragging enemies over your poison and survive.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on maximum health in a close-range cone, so minimize the time you spend near him. If Rumble E Electro Harpoon's first shot hits, immediately create distance before the second shot arrives. Also avoid getting pinned down by the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer.

Shen.build: Build tenacity early to prepare for Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t stack resistance in just one direction. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Shen.combo: Check which way Shen will go before you fling him. Near a turret, fling him toward the inside of the turret and use Singed W Mega Adhesive to slow his escape.
Shen.escape: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to engage. If Shen can still use Shen R Stand United, don’t go deep just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down. Look for an opening before Shen R Stand United is available again, and block Shen’s escape route with Singed W Mega Adhesive.
Shen.fight: Keep Singed Q Poison Trail on as you pass by Shen and lay down poison, but don’t stand still and trade attacks. Counterattack right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, and if Shen doesn’t back off, catch him with Singed E Fling. When the fight ends, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Shen.laning: Early on, focus on lane control over kills to keep Shen occupied with farming. Pushing the wave under Shen’s turret can force him to lose lane resources when he uses Shen R Stand United to influence another lane. When clearing the next wave behind the turret, choose the moment right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side.
Shen.phase: Once you have two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure. In the late game, don’t let time pass without getting items.
Shen.teamfight: Watch for Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt as you turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team. Use Singed P Noxious Slipstream to refresh your movement speed, then use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team. Keep moving after the fling to draw multiple enemies along and survive.
Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, Shen Q Twilight Assault can make its empowered attacks easy to land. Dodge Shen E Shadow Dash, and move out of the path of the Spirit Blade returning to Shen.

Sion.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor, so dodge it instead of relying on items alone. If you keep getting caught in immobilizing crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash.
Sion.combo: Keep Singed Q Poison Trail on as you move, leaving poison along Sion’s path. Before you fling him, check whether Sion will land in a favorable position behind Singed.
Sion.escape: You can reduce the risk of getting caught by approaching after dodging the stun and knock-up from Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side. After using Singed E Fling, overlap Singed W Mega Adhesive at the landing point.
Sion.fight: When Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lay poison as you pass by Sion. If he holds his ground instead of backing off, catch him with Singed E Fling, but don’t stand still and trade basic attacks. If Sion Q Decimating Smash charges, circle to the side to avoid its stun and knock-up.
Sion.laning: Singed can push the wave to pressure Sion’s farming and deny him time to move to other lanes. Right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, you can go behind the turret and clear the next wave with Singed Q Poison Trail. When the fight ends, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Sion.phase: Once you have two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure, but in the late game, don't let time pass without getting items.
Sion.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team to gain movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream. Dodge Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught to the side of its charge, and use Singed E Fling when you can throw an enemy in a direction favorable to your team. Keep moving after the fling to draw pursuit, and create space to reposition when Sion P Glory in Death activates after he falls.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash knocks you up and stuns you if it charges for long, so move to the side when you see it charging. Don’t face Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side of its charge. Sion E Roar of the Slayer slows you and reduces your armor, so be extra careful about your distance right after it hits.

Skarner.build: Consider Quicksilver Sash early to break the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Magic resistance won’t stop Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or E Ixtal’s Impact, and there is also maximum health-based damage to account for, so avoid building heavily into health alone.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, approach, and throw him with Singed E Fling. Check which side of Singed Skarner will land on before you fling him.
