Skarner.escape: Right after you bait Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is your chance to engage. If you throw Skarner with Singed E Fling then, he can’t immediately escape with that dash. If Skarner R Impale is still available, account for the range at which he can catch and drag you before engaging.
Skarner.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, lay poison as you pass by Skarner, and keep moving. Don’t stand still and trade basic attacks; catch him with Singed E Fling right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down. Don’t stay within range for Skarner to stick close and chain empowered Q attacks.
Skarner.laning: Early on, keep your distance and push the wave with Singed Q Poison Trail; when the fight ends, turn off Q to save mana. Only try to clear the next wave behind the enemy turret right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. Watch for Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact by keeping your back away from walls and moving through open space.
Skarner.phase: Once you have two core items, continuously pushing the lane is strong, but you fall off if you reach the late game without items. Skarner also becomes harder to deal with as he stacks tank items, both in damage and in his ability to catch you, so it’s important to delay that point.
Skarner.teamfight: Keep Singed Q Poison Trail on and keep moving, using the movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream to disrupt the enemy formation. Use Singed E Fling when the direction favors your team, and don’t stop to fight where you flung them. Watch the range of Skarner R Impale, and when near the edges of the dragon or Baron pit, position yourself so you can’t be dragged across terrain.

Teemo.build: Build magic resistance first because Teemo’s main damage is magic. Before team fights, use Oracle Lens to check key paths for Teemo R Noxious Trap.
Teemo.combo: Check which side of Singed Teemo will land on before you fling him. Near a turret, throw Teemo toward the inside of the turret and place adhesive at the landing point to delay his escape.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is a good window to engage. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed but doesn’t provide a mobility skill to create distance, so if you close the gap, catch him with Singed E Fling. If you’re sure you can win the fight, you can buffer Singed E Fling during Flash so you can throw him as soon as you arrive.
Teemo.fight: Avoid short trades where you take a hit inside Teemo’s range and then back away. If you decide to engage, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, lay poison as you pass by Teemo, and catch him with Singed E Fling if he holds his ground. Even if Teemo Q Blinding Dart blinds you, don’t insist on using basic attacks; fight with abilities or back off briefly.
Teemo.laning: Push the wave to keep Teemo in lane. Right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, clear the next wave behind the turret with poison. Pushing the lane also creates an opportunity to engage on Teemo with your jungler.
Teemo.phase: Once you have two core items, keep pushing the lane to give Teemo less time to place mushrooms. In the late game, don’t let time pass without getting items.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap in front of objectives and in narrow paths, and watch familiar shortcuts when retreating. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. When you have a favorable angle, use Singed E Fling to send an enemy carry toward your team, then keep moving to draw enemies toward you.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart blocks basic attacks, but it doesn’t block Singed Q Poison Trail or Singed E Fling. Even one basic attack from Teemo E Toxic Shot applies ongoing poison damage, so stay out of range if you’re not ready to engage. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s stealth in brush where you have no vision, and be careful in narrow paths where Teemo R Noxious Trap is easy to place.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks, and consider an effect that reduces attack speed. Given the maximum health-based damage and resistance reduction from Trundle R Subjugate, prioritize getting out of its range instead of continuing to stack only health or resistance.
Trundle.combo: After Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, approach, and throw Trundle behind you with Singed E Fling. If you want to reduce the healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute, apply poison while Singed R Insanity Potion is active.
Trundle.escape: After Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down is your chance to engage. Trundle has no skill to create distance on his own, so when you have an angle to win, catch him with Singed E Fling and overlap Singed W Mega Adhesive at the landing point. If Trundle W Frozen Domain is still active, back out of its area first.
Trundle.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lay poison as you pass by Trundle, but don’t stand still and trade basic attacks. If Trundle W Frozen Domain is placed, use Singed P Noxious Slipstream’s movement speed to back out and then approach again. If Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you can win the fight, catch him with Singed E Fling.
Trundle.laning: Early on, don’t fight Trundle head-on for long; push with Singed Q Poison Trail to keep him in lane. Trundle P King’s Tribute heals him whenever nearby units die, so don’t drag out the lane phase by only chipping away at his health. When clearing the next wave behind the turret, go there only right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side.
Trundle.phase: Singed is strong at continuously pushing the lane in the mid game once he has two core items, and falls off if time passes in the late game without items, so don’t handle Trundle’s side lane alone.
Trundle.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, avoid fighting him alone; use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team and keep moving.
Trundle.watch: Trundle W Frozen Domain increases his attack speed and healing, so don’t fight him inside it; back out and wait for its duration to end. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes in narrow paths, so fight in open areas and move to the side as soon as the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, your resistances are reduced and Trundle becomes tankier, so create distance.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Get Plated Steelcaps early to withstand his basic attacks, and consider Dead Man’s Plate for a playstyle that draws enemies while moving.
Tryndamere.combo: Check which way Tryndamere will go before you fling him. Near a turret, throw him toward the inside of the turret and overlap the adhesive to extend the time it takes him to escape.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used to clear the wave or engage is your chance to go in. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash comes back easily among many minions, so draw him toward an area without minions, then chain Singed E Fling with Singed W Mega Adhesive. When backing away, face Tryndamere and walk backward to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lay poison as you pass by Tryndamere, but don’t stand still and trade basic attacks. Catch him with Singed E Fling right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down. Deal damage again after Tryndamere R Undying Rage ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere when he goes for last hits to stop him from building Fury. Push the wave with Singed Q Poison Trail to keep him in lane, but when clearing the next wave behind the turret, choose the moment right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. When the fight ends, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Tryndamere.phase: Once you have two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure, but Singed falls off if he reaches the late game without items.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the enemy team, refreshing your movement speed with Singed P Noxious Slipstream. If you have a favorable angle, use Singed E Fling to throw an enemy carry toward your team, then keep moving to draw pursuit. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, buy time with Singed W Mega Adhesive and keep your distance.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere P Battle Fury is stacked, his critical strikes are dangerous, and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust can heal him. Create distance when he starts hitting minions to build Fury. Tryndamere R Undying Rage makes him unable to die, so instead of dumping damage into him, buy time with Singed W Mega Adhesive and back away.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw has mixed damage types and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone won’t block all his damage. He also deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building heavily into health alone.
Udyr.combo: Look for a window after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s empowered state ends, when he can no longer escape.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to engage. After you take one stun, use the window when he can’t immediately stun the same target again, but save Singed E Fling while Udyr’s E empowered state makes him immune to immobilizing effects.
Udyr.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and lay poison as you pass by Udyr, but don’t stop to trade basic attacks. After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is used and you’ve taken one stun, use Singed E Fling to reposition. Pressure him once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, and reduce his healing with poison while Singed R Insanity Potion is active.
Udyr.laning: Early on, avoid forcing fights, considering the damage and mana cost of Singed Q Poison Trail. If Udyr is out of sight, don’t move forward; use vision on key paths and jungle entrances to track his route. Right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side, you can push the wave in and clear the next one with poison.
Udyr.phase: Once you have two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure, but in the late game, you’ll fall off if you only let time pass without items.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to take down Udyr first when he’s tanky from defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and run through the formation to gain speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream; if the direction is favorable, use Singed E Fling to send an enemy carry toward your team. Keep moving afterward so multiple enemies chase you.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes the gap quickly and stuns you, so keep your distance right after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals damage based on your maximum health with empowered basic attacks, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm slows and deals area damage, so don’t stand still and fight him.

Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Items that reduce the attack speed from Volibear P The Relentless Storm are also useful. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your max health, so think carefully before building heavily into health alone.
Volibear.combo: After Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are no longer available, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, approach, and use Singed E Fling to throw him in a favorable direction. Near a turret, you can fling Volibear toward the inside of its range, but be careful when he can disable the turret with Volibear R Stormbringer.
Volibear.escape: When engaging, check whether the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash has been used. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, he can disengage with Volibear R Stormbringer, so use Singed E Fling during the window when both mobility abilities have been fully spent.
Volibear.fight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and pass by Volibear's side to lay poison, but do not stand still and trade basic attacks. Catch him with Singed E Fling after the stacks from Volibear P The Relentless Storm wear off and Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer have been fully spent. While Singed R Insanity Potion is active, your poison applies grievous wounds, which helps counter the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul.
Volibear.laning: After pushing the wave in, if the enemy jungler has been seen on the opposite side, clear the next wave behind the turret with poison to keep Volibear tied to the lane. Do not stay under a turret at low health while Volibear R Stormbringer is available.
Volibear.phase: After getting two core items, keep pushing the lane to keep the enemy tied down, but do not spend late game without items.
Volibear.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run through the enemy team, and refresh Singed P Noxious Slipstream's movement speed. If Volibear has stacked Volibear P The Relentless Storm by attacking minions or monsters, avoid fighting him while those stacks remain; after the stacks wear off, use Singed E Fling in a favorable direction. Do not stay in place after the fling; keep moving to draw enemy pursuit.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed before he approaches and stuns you, so stay outside the range of his empowered basic attack until it expires. When you see the indicator for Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. After Volibear W Frenzied Maul marks you, avoid extended fights that let him heal.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Get Plated Steelcaps early to withstand basic attacks, and consider Dead Man's Plate for a mobile fighting style. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail and keep moving to lead Yasuo along a poisoned path. Before flinging him, check where behind you he will land.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, his Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks reset, creating an opportunity to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so do not go deep just because he used it once; look for a chance to catch him with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back. Place Singed W Mega Adhesive along the retreat path and catch him with Singed E Fling.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield first with Singed Q Poison Trail, then commit to the trade. Do not stand still and trade basic attacks; keep poison active and move past Yasuo's side. Catch him with Singed E Fling when he has thrown his tornado and reset his stacks, and his available escape routes using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade have also been reduced.
Yasuo.laning: Yasuo uses minions as stepping stones to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so manage the wave to keep it thin and pushing toward your side, making it harder for him to get close. Try pushing the lane and clearing the next wave behind the turret with Singed Q Poison Trail right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. When the fight ends, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Yasuo.phase: After getting two core items, keep pushing the lane to apply pressure, and avoid spending late game without items.
Yasuo.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run through the enemy team, and pass between champions to keep Singed P Noxious Slipstream's movement speed boost going. Before using Singed E Fling on Yasuo, check that the direction favors your allies. Do not stay in place after the fling; keep moving and draw multiple enemies into chasing you.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a tornado after landing two consecutive hits, so if its stacks are full, move off the line and dodge to the side. A knock-up can lead into Yasuo R Last Breath, and minions let him close the gap quickly with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so manage your distance.

Yone.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the spots where Yone telegraphs his attacks. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build resistances without leaning too heavily toward one type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only add health.
Yone.combo: Near a turret, fling Yone toward the inside of its range and place adhesive along his escape path.
Yone.escape: Look for an opportunity to engage after Yone Q Mortal Steel's gust and Yone E Soul Unbound are no longer available. If Yone R Fate Sealed is still unavailable, he will have a harder time escaping after you land Singed E Fling. If Yone enters first in his spirit form, use the Singed E Fling and Singed W Mega Adhesive combo to immobilize him then.
Yone.fight: Do not stand still and fight; keep Singed Q Poison Trail active and pass by Yone's side to lay poison. If Yone holds his ground instead of backing away, or after he has used a mobility ability, catch him with Singed E Fling, but first check that the direction favors you.
Yone.laning: When pushing the wave and clearing the next one behind the turret, choose the moment right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side.
Yone.phase: In mid game, after two core items, you are strong at constantly pushing the lane, but you fall off if you reach late game without items.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave's shield does not grow, and check whether you are the furthest back in your formation to prepare for Yone R Fate Sealed. Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run through the formation, and use Singed P Noxious Slipstream to gain speed; then use Singed E Fling when throwing Yone toward your allies is favorable. Keep moving after the fling to draw pursuit.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a tornado, keep your distance until the stacks disappear. If he follows up with Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed, Singed will have a hard time escaping on his own, so do not approach just because one mobility ability is down.

Yorick.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Yorick.combo: Approach with Singed Q Poison Trail active and decide first which direction to fling Yorick. Near a turret, fling him toward the inside of its range and place adhesive at his landing spot.
Yorick.escape: Engage after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist and waiting for Yorick W Dark Procession to be used. Yorick has no mobility, so when you have an angle to catch him, slow his retreat with Singed W Mega Adhesive and reposition him with Singed E Fling.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward, turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, and keep moving to lay poison. If Yorick holds his ground instead of backing away, change his position with Singed E Fling. When the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites becomes a problem, activate Singed R Insanity Potion and lead him over your poison to apply grievous wounds.
Yorick.laning: Early on, do not stand still and trade basic attacks; move with Singed Q Poison Trail and push the wave so Yorick cannot stack graves on his side. After pushing the wave under the turret, choose the moment to cross over and clear the next wave right after the enemy jungler is spotted on the opposite side. When the fight ends, turn off Singed Q Poison Trail to save mana.
Yorick.phase: After two core items, constantly pushing the lane becomes strong, but you fall off if you reach late game without items.
Yorick.teamfight: Turn on Singed Q Poison Trail, run through the enemy team, and use Singed P Noxious Slipstream's movement speed. After flinging an enemy carry toward your allies with Singed E Fling, keep moving to draw pursuit from multiple enemies. Before fighting Yorick, clear his Mist Walkers first to reduce his damage.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your max health, so dodge its trajectory. If you are trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall to break it, and do not start a fight where many graves have accumulated. Watch out for the max health-based damage and mark from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles as well.
